stimulus.question: Checkout is reported to show elevated errors in the OTel Demo. Using the authorized metrics range query and trace search for the last 5 minutes, determine whether checkout and its dependency calls (payment, product-catalog, cart, currency, shipping, email) show failures or elevated latency, cite trace ids, and return a json investigation report.

claims.text: Checkout's spans with status_code=STATUS_CODE_ERROR show an increase of 0 in the last 5 minutes on every operation observed (oteldemo.CheckoutService/PlaceOrder, oteldemo.CheckoutService/prepareOrderItems, oteldemo.PaymentService/Charge, oteldemo.CartService/EmptyCart), while the same operations have non-zero non-error span increases (e.g. PlaceOrder 2.5, CurrencyService/Convert 7.5, ProductCatalogService/GetProduct 5.0 spans per 300s).
